steps.en: Install BMAD skills into your coding tool
steps.zh: 把 BMAD skills 安装进 coding tool

steps.en: Ask the BMAD hub to set up the target project
steps.zh: 让 BMAD hub 设置目标项目

steps.en: Installs the selected method skills and shared project runtime
steps.zh: 安装选定的方法 skills 与项目共享 runtime

steps.en: Give bmad-build a change, answer questions, and approve its plan
steps.zh: 向 bmad-build 提交改动，回答问题并批准计划

steps.en: Sizes the path, carries decisions forward, builds, reviews, and verifies
steps.zh: 确定路径规模，传递决定，再构建、review 与验证

value.en: One role-aware delivery path carries approved intent from planning into verified code
value.zh: 一条角色化交付路径把已批准意图从规划带到验证后的代码
